
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readr)
library(INLA)
library(fmesher)
library(sf)
library(inlabru)

source(here('src', 'plots.R'))
source(here('src', 'helpers.R'))
```

```{r}
events <- read_csv(here('data', 'events_dfl.csv')) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(team_with_poss = team_id)

tracking <- read_csv(here('data', 'tracking_dfl_secs.csv')) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  own_goal_direction()


pitch_length <- 105
pitch_width <- 68
```

```{r}
shots <- events %>%
  filter(type == "SHOT", is.na(subtype)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(
    shot_time = round(start_time_s),
    start_window = shot_time - 40,
    end_window   = shot_time
  ) %>% 
  select(match_id, period, start_window, end_window, team_with_poss, success) %>% 
  filter(success %in% 'TRUE') %>% 
  slice(1)

setDT(tracking)
setDT(shots)

tracking <- tracking[, time_seg_original := time_seg]
tracking_inla <- tracking[shots,
  on = .(
    match_id,
    period,
    time_seg >= start_window,
    time_seg <= end_window
  ),
  nomatch = 0
] %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(player_id != 'ball', !is.na(x_pitch)) %>% 
  select(-time_seg, -time_seg.1) %>% 
  rename(time_seg = time_seg_original)
```

```{r}
# T MESH
interval <- 5
t_start <- floor(min(tracking_inla$time_seg) / interval) * interval
t_end   <- ceiling(max(tracking_inla$time_seg) / interval) * interval

tknots <- seq(from = t_start, to = t_end, by = interval)

tracking_inla <- tracking_inla %>% 
  filter(time_seg %in% tknots)
```

```{r}
tracking_sf <- st_as_sf(tracking_inla, coords = c("x_pitch", "y_pitch"))
tracking_sf$time_idx <- as.numeric(as.factor(tracking_sf$time_seg))
```

```{r}
pitch_x <- c(0, 105)
pitch_y <- c(0, 68)

pitch_boundary <- matrix(c(
  pitch_x[1], pitch_y[1],
  pitch_x[2], pitch_y[1],
  pitch_x[2], pitch_y[2],
  pitch_x[1], pitch_y[2],
  pitch_x[1], pitch_y[1]
), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)

boundary <- fm_segm(pitch_boundary)

mesh <- fm_mesh_2d_inla(
  boundary = boundary,
  max.edge = c(3, 10),   
  offset = c(2, 15),
  cutoff = 1      
)

pitch_poly <- st_polygon(list(as.matrix(pitch_boundary))) %>% st_sfc()
pitch_poly <- st_sf(geometry = pitch_poly)
```

```{r}
plot(mesh)
lines(pitch_boundary, col="red", lwd=2)
```

```{r}
spde <- inla.spde2.matern(mesh = mesh, alpha = 2)
```

```{r}
n_time <- length(unique(tracking_sf$time_idx))

cmp <- geometry + time_idx ~ field(
  main = geometry, 
  model = spde, 
  group = time_idx, 
  control.group = list(model = "ar1")
) + Intercept(1)

fit <- lgcp(
  components = cmp,
  data = tracking_sf,
  samplers = pitch_poly,
  domain = list(
    geometry = mesh, 
    time_idx = seq_len(n_time)
  )
)
```

```{r}
pixels <- fm_pixels(mesh, mask = pitch_poly)
time_steps <- seq_len(n_time)

grid_st <- do.call(
  rbind, 
  lapply(time_steps, function(t) {
    p <- pixels
    p$time_idx <- t
    p
  })
)

lambda_pred <- predict(
  fit, 
  grid_st, 
  ~ exp(field + Intercept),
  n.samples = 100
)
```

```{r}
lambda_df <- lambda_pred %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
    y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame() 

ggplot(lambda_df) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = mean)) +
  annotate_pitch(
    dimensions = pitch_international,
    fill       = NA,
    colour     = "#C8C8C8",
    limits     = FALSE
  ) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~time_idx)
```

```{r}
pixels <- fm_pixels(mesh, mask = pitch_poly)
target_time <- n_time + n_forecast # This is time_idx 4

# Create the grid for the forecasted time step
grid_forecast <- pixels
grid_forecast$time_idx <- target_time

# Run the prediction
lambda_pred_future <- predict(
  fit, 
  grid_forecast, 
  ~ exp(field + Intercept),
  n.samples = 100 
)

# Extract coordinates from the sf POINT object
lambda_df_future <- lambda_pred_future %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
    y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame() 

ggplot(lambda_df_future) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = mean)) +
  annotate_pitch(
    dimensions = pitch_international,
    fill       = NA,
    colour     = "#C8C8C8",
    limits     = FALSE
  ) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Intensity\n(pts/m²)") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Forecasted Spatio-Temporal Intensity: Time Step", target_time),
    subtitle = "Units: Expected number of points per square meter"
  )
```

```{r}
all_time_segs <- tracking %>% 
  filter(!is.na(x_pitch)) %>% 
  pull(time_seg) %>% 
  unique()

true_time_seg_4 <- all_time_segs[8]

true_points_4 <- tracking %>% 
  filter(time_seg == true_time_seg_4, !is.na(x_pitch)) %>% 
  slice(1:22)

ggplot(lambda_df_future) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = mean)) +
  geom_point(
    data = true_points_4, 
    aes(x = x_pitch, y = y_pitch), 
    color = "cyan", 
    size = 2.5, 
    shape = 16,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate_pitch(
    dimensions = pitch_international,
    fill       = NA,
    colour     = "#C8C8C8",
    limits     = FALSE
  ) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Intensity\n(pts/m²)") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal()
```
